decisions.reason: The literal likewise drops 戊寅 and renders 衛尉卿 as Imperial Stud; Chamberlain of the Court of the Imperial Insignia is the correct office.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 戊寅，制以大寶于闐國進奉使、檢校太尉馬繼榮為鎮國大將軍，使副黃門將軍、國子少監張再通為試衛尉卿

decisions.reason: 贈太尉 is Grand Commandant; grand guardian would be 太保.
The literal's Grand Guardian is the same mistranslation of 太尉.

claimRevisions.reason: The accepted repair shows 尚書屯田員外郎 is Tuntian vice director, not a granaries director; the English office label followed the bad translation.

label.en: director in the ministry of granaries
vice director of the Tuntian (military-farms) bureau

claimRevisions.reason: 庫部員外郎 is a vice-directorship of the armory bureau; the extracted English used director, following the unrepaired translation.

label.en: vice director of the armory bureau

claimRevisions.reason: The advanced repair restores 希萼 as Xi'e; the extracted English personal name Ma Xiege was produced by the bad romanization.
The given-name English Xiege is the same false reading of 希萼; Xi'e is the restored value.
